newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu 3,226 to dollar for Sept 19 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu 3,226 to dollar for Sept 19 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate at 3,226 to the dollar for September 19.
This reference rate was set on Tuesday as a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators.
It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
The leu's reference rate set on Monday for September 18 is 3,205 to the dollar.It was 3,196 on Tuesday. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
